caption:
Digital transformation provides the means for SIDS to lead as ‘Digital Islands’ to innovate and manage the energy value chain, transforming their model for development through sustainable energy. 🏝️

As small island digital states, SIDS are leveraging AI, IoT, and remote sensing to optimize energy planning, predict climate risks, and integrate energy with water, food, and transport systems:

🌊 Pacific SIDS are using open data platforms and digital assessments to enhance energy planning and financing transparency
☀️ Caribbean SIDS are integrating AI and IoT into energy systems to improve smart grid management
🏝️ AIS SIDS are upskilling and reskilling workforces needed for a resilient and inclusive energy transition that can empower women, youth and entrepreneurs through digital.

SIDS are also advancing the use of data through initiatives like the UNDP Data Platform for SIDS, leading data-driven policymaking. 💡👉 https://lnkd.in/ecnQjT_j

@‌UNDP is supporting SIDS in strengthening regulatory frameworks, unlocking financing, and building local technical capacity to harness digital innovation for accelerating their #EnergyRevolution. ⚡️

📌 Explore how digital innovation is shaping SIDS' energy future in this new policy paper on Advancing a Just Energy Transition in SIDS 👉 http://go.undp.org/34Q
